content.tex: INVESTIGATION ODD SETS
In this investigation, you will look at calculations made from an odd number of connected integers.
Use these steps. STEP 1 Write down an odd number of integers that increase by the same positive integer each time. STEP 2 Multiply the first and last integers. STEP 3 Square the middle integer.
